title: Anecdotes of Discipline and Faith
english: I visited the holy father Macarius at the very midday, and burning exceedingly with thirst I asked for water to drink; but he says: Be satisfied with the shade; for many now traveling or sailing are lacking even this.

Then, while I was speaking words to him concerning training in self-control: Take courage, he says, child, in twenty whole years I have taken no satiety of bread, nor of water, nor of sleep; for I ate my bread by weight, I drank water by measure, and leaning myself against the walls, I snatched a small part of sleep.
The death of his father was announced to one of the monks; but to the one who announced it he says: Stop blaspheming; for my father is immortal.
One of the brothers asked one of the elders whether he orders him, on visiting the house, to eat with his mother and sisters; but he said: With a woman you shall not eat.

One of the brothers possessed only a gospel, and having sold it he gave it for food to the hungry, uttering a word worthy of remembrance: For I, he says, have sold the very word that says to me: Sell your possessions and give to the poor.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Five Causes of Monastic Action
english: There is an island near Alexandria, situated on the northern part of the lake called Maria, where the most approved monk of the camp of the gnostics lives alone; he determined that all things performed by the monks are performed for five reasons: through God, through nature, through habit, through necessity, and through the works of the hands.

The same one said again that virtue is one by nature, but is given form in the powers of the soul; for the solar light is formless, he says, but it is naturally shaped together with the windows through which it enters.

Another of the monks said: For this reason I cut away pleasures, he said, so that I might cut off the pretexts of thumos; for I know him always fighting for the sake of pleasures, disturbing my mind and driving away my knowledge. And one of the elders said that love does not know how to keep deposits of food or money. The same one says: I do not know, having been deceived twice in the same way by demons. All...

title: Practical Instructions and Final Blessing
english: On the one hand, it is not possible to love the brothers equally, but it is possible to encounter all dispassionately, being free of grudge and hatred. One must love the priests after the Lord, those cleansing us through the holy mysteries and praying for us; and one must honor our elders as the angels, for they are the ones anointing us for the struggles and healing the bites of wild beasts.

But now, let these things have been said to you regarding practice, most desired brother Anatolius — as many things as by the grace of the Holy Spirit, gleaning while our grape was ripening at sowing-time, we have found. But if the sun of righteousness shall shine steadily upon us and the cluster becomes ripe, then we shall also drink its wine which gladdens the heart of man, through the prayers and intercessions of the righteous Gregory who planted me and of the now-holy Fathers who water me, and by the power of Christ Jesus our Lord who makes me grow, to whom be glory and dominion for the ages of ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
